_comment: FTSE 250 index level at most recent London close. The FTSE 250 is a cleaner read on the domestic UK economy than the FTSE 100 (which is dominated by global commodity and pharma names). LSEG does not expose a free index-level JSON feed; the number is transcribed from the published closing price. The adapter's freshness guard rejects fixtures older than 14 days so a missed refresh surfaces in the ingest audit. 2026-09-01 refresh: last completed session is Friday 28 August 2026 = 24938.8 (Yahoo Finance ^FTMC daily; Monday 31 August was the Summer bank holiday, Tuesday 1 September session still open at refresh). Live path tries EODHD FTMC.INDX then Yahoo ^FTMC, skipping any in-progress daily bar until 16:35 Europe/London. TODO(source): an authorised LSEG index-licence vendor would let us drop this fixture.
release_schedule: Every London trading day at ~16:30; editorial fixture refreshed weekly.
